notes: raw_invalid_count may include rejected primary candidates.
selected output is considered safe if deterministic fallback or safe_fallback was selected and no selected_output_invalid_count is reported.
deterministic fallback is allowed up to 10% for 100-turn smoke evaluation.

narration_grounding_valid.message: Selected narration outputs should be safe. Rejected-primary violations are allowed when a valid safe_fallback or deterministic fallback is selected.

scenario_progression_repeats_bounded.expected: repeated no-progress graph actions are suppressed and remain bounded
scenario_progression_repeats_bounded.message: Scenario graph actions should not loop or crash autoplay.

loop_detection.message: No repeated-action loop windows should be detected.

mechanics_coverage_required.message: Required RPG mechanics should be exercised by real runtime/story-graph evidence.

story_arc_resolution_present.expected: at least one completed or failed story arc in 100-turn run
story_arc_resolution_present.message: The 100-turn campaign should demonstrate deterministic story arc closure.

story_arc_aftermath_present.expected: at least one bounded aftermath event from completed or failed arcs
story_arc_aftermath_present.message: Completed arcs should create deterministic aftermath.

faction_reputation_changed.expected: at least one faction reputation delta
faction_reputation_changed.message: Arc aftermath should produce bounded faction reputation consequences.

followup_arc_progression_present.expected: at least one seeded follow-up arc progresses
followup_arc_progression_present.message: Seeded follow-up arcs should advance deterministically after their prerequisites are met.

faction_pressure_present.expected: at least one faction pressure event
faction_pressure_present.message: Faction reputation changes should produce bounded pressure or support events.

followup_arc_resolution_present.expected: at least one progressed follow-up arc resolves or escalates
followup_arc_resolution_present.message: Follow-up arcs should not remain only progressed; at least one should resolve or branch.

escalation_branch_seeded.expected: at least one escalation branch seeded from follow-up resolution
escalation_branch_seeded.message: Resolved follow-up arcs should create bounded escalation branches.

pressure_pacing_active.expected: pressure events accepted and either old pacing rejected spam or direct graph pressure bridge is active
pressure_pacing_active.message: Faction pressure should be paced or represented by direct graph lifecycle pressure evidence.

world_signal_summary_present.message: Report should separate pure aftermath signals from global world signals.

escalation_arc_progression_present.expected: at least one escalation arc progresses
escalation_arc_progression_present.message: Seeded escalation arcs should advance deterministically.

world_state_compression_active.expected: compression events occur and state budget is respected
world_state_compression_active.message: Long-run campaigns need bounded world state and memory compression.

npc_agency_present.expected: at least one deterministic NPC agency event
npc_agency_present.message: 100-turn readiness should demonstrate schedule-driven NPC agency.

economy_pressure_present.expected: at least one deterministic economy pressure/resource sink event
economy_pressure_present.message: Long-run campaigns should include recurring resource pressure and sinks.

combat_lifecycle_present.expected: at least one deterministic combat encounter with lifecycle events
combat_lifecycle_present.message: Long-run campaigns should include combat lifecycle/consequence pressure.

faction_consequence_present.expected: at least one deterministic long-term faction consequence
faction_consequence_present.message: Faction reputation should produce long-term consequences.

npc_reaction_present.expected: at least one deterministic NPC reaction to faction/consequence state
npc_reaction_present.message: NPCs should react to long-term faction consequences.

dialogue_action_relevance_ok.expected: dialogue selected for each turn is action-relevant or deterministically repaired
dialogue_action_relevance_ok.message: Player-facing narration/NPC dialogue must match the current action type.

turn_action_consistency_ok.expected: visible player action, progress action, resolver action, and hook action context all derive from canonical_turn_action
turn_action_consistency_ok.message: A turn must not mix player actions from different commands.

suppressed_selection_guard_ok.expected: suppressed selected actions are retargeted before resolver execution
suppressed_selection_guard_ok.message: Suppressed graph actions must not keep driving player-agent turns.
